# DFW Improved

> > DFW Improved is a home remodeling contractor specializing in kitchen and bathroom renovations across the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex.

DFW Improved serves residential clients throughout North Texas communities including Frisco, Plano, McKinney, Allen, Denton, and Dallas. The company showcases portfolio projects featuring luxury finishes, custom designs, quartz countertops, and modern transitional styles.

## Key Topics

- Kitchen Remodeling
- Bathroom Renovation
- Luxury Home Remodel
- Quartz Countertops
- Custom Closets
- Gray & White Kitchen Design
- Master Bath Renovation
- Laundry Room Remodel
- Transitional Style
- Frisco TX

- DFW Service Area
- Newport Brass Fixtures
